typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID as string,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE as string,
		SC_SCHEME as string,
		SC_SUBSCHEME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SUBSTRING(R.MR_CLAIM_ID, 1, 10)) AS ROOT_CLCL_ID,  	CONVERT(VARCHAR(200), P.CCERT_LEAD_TYPE) AS CCERT_LEAD_TYPE, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(25), P.SC_SCHEME) AS SC_SCHEME, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), P.SC_SUBSCHEME) AS SC_SUBSCHEME FROM OPS.linked_MEDICAL_RECORD_RECEIPT R INNER JOIN OPS.PBI_DIM_ANALYTIC_PROJECT_LOOKUP P ON P.SC_SUBSCHEME = R.MR_SUBSCHEME WHERE 1=1 	AND R.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND=\'N\'  	AND DATEADD(DD, 0, DATEDIFF(DD, 0, R.MR_DATE)) > DATEADD(DD, 0, DATEDIFF(DD, 0, GETDATE())) - ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID as string,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE as string,
		SC_SCHEME as string,
		SC_SUBSCHEME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE,
		SC_SCHEME,
		SC_SUBSCHEME)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
